verdict_reason: B2N's own success criteria (evidence_observed=true / creator-funding evidence) cannot be satisfied within B2N's own stated budget (max 1 physical request per member) using any provider method that exists in this repository. The 1-request adapter (b2w_projection.py) is provably migration-lineage-only and never produces qualifying evidence. The evidence-producing sequence (b2z_execution_boundary.py) provably requires 3 requests per member, which is the 2B2Z contract's budget, not B2N's. Per explicit instruction, this HOLD does not infer Helius/endpoint compatibility from 2B2Z, does not silently widen B2N's request budget, and does not proceed to provider selection until this contract-level insufficiency is resolved by a human/engineering decision.
options_for_human_decision_not_chosen_he: Option A: widen B2N's per-member budget from 1 to 3 to match the B2Z sequence (this would be a contract change, not a P3A action, and is explicitly prohibited from being made silently by this milestone).

Option B: redefine B2N's success criteria so migration-lineage-only evidence (evidence_observed remaining False, provenance_complete=True) is treated as a qualifying/sufficient B2N outcome for this milestone's narrower purpose -- this would also be a contract change requiring explicit human sign-off, not something inferred here.

Option C: leave B2N's scope as strictly migration-lineage qualification (matching what MigrationGetTransactionAdapter actually proves) and treat full creator-funding evidence acquisition as an explicitly separate, future milestone with its own 3-request/member authorization -- this preserves B2N's existing 1-request/member ceiling exactly as qualified, at the cost of B2N never reaching its own currently-stated success criterion.
None of these options are selected or acted on by this artifact. This is a report of an unresolved contract gap, not a proposal being executed.
